chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Amr ibn Abi al-Miqdam, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'I and my father went out until we were between the Grave and the Pulpit, and behold, there was a group of the Shites, so he greeted them.'
Then he said: 'By Allah, I love your aromas and your spirits, so help me with that through piety and striving. And know that our Wilayah cannot be attained except through piety and striving.'

And whoever from among you follows a servant (Imam), let him emulate his actions. You are the Shites of Allah, and you are the Helpers of Allah, and you are the foremost of the former ones, and the foremost of the later ones, and the foremost in the world, and the foremost in the Hereafter to Paradise.

We have guaranteed Paradise for you by the guarantee of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and the guarantee of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). By Allah, there is no level of Paradise where there are more spirits than yours, so compete in the virtues of the levels.
You are the good ones, and your women are the good ones. Every believing woman is a virgin Hourie, and every believing man is a Truthful one.

And indeed, the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said to Qanbar: 'O Qanbar, receive good news, convey good news, and rejoice with good news. By Allah, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) passed away while he was angry with his community except for the Shites.'
Indeed, for everything there is an honor, and the honor of Islam is the Shites. Indeed, for everything there is a pillar, and the pillar of Islam is the Shites.
Indeed, for everything there is a chief, and the chief of Islam is the Shites. Indeed, for everything there is an honor/prestige, and the prestige of Islam is the Shites.

Indeed, for everything there is a master, and the master of gatherings is the gatherings of the Shites. Indeed, for everything there is an Imam, and the Imam of the earth is the land upon which the Shites reside.

By Allah, if it were not for what is in the earth from among you, an eye would never have seen herbs. By Allah, if it were not for what is in the earth from among you, Allah would not have favored those who oppose you.
Nor would they have attained the good things. They have no share in the world, nor any share in the Hereafter.
Every hostile one (Nasibi), even if he worships and strives, is attributed to this Verse: 'A hostile one toiling, entering into a burning fire.'
So every hostile one who strives, his deed is vain.
Our Shites speak with the Light of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and those who oppose them speak with instinct/biological needs.
By Allah, there is no servant from our Shites who sleeps except that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, raises his soul to the sky and blesses it.
So if its term has come, He places it in the treasures of His mercy, and in the gardens of Paradise, and in the shade of His Throne.
And if its term is delayed, He sends it back with His trusted angels to return it to the body from which it came out, to dwell in it.

By Allah, those of you who perform Hajj and Umrah are the special ones of Allah, Mighty and Majestic. And the poor among you are the rich ones, and the rich among you are the contented ones. And all of you are the people of His call and the people of His response.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Shites in Islam according to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This foundational hadith from al-Kafi underscores the Shia doctrine of 'Alawiyyah' (loyalty to the Imams), asserting that true Wilayah is contingent upon piety and scholarly striving rather than mere nominal affiliation. It elevates the Shia as the 'pillars' and 'apex' of Islam, linking their spiritual presence to cosmic sustenance, while contrasting their accepted status with the 'nasiba' (loyalists/opponents) whose efforts are rendered void. The text also provides a unique cosmological view of the soul's journey during sleep and death, affirming the divine protection and special status of the Shia community.
